prompt: Can you add one minute to the time of the title track from the album released by Ray Charles in the year before Phil Quartararo took over as president of its record label?
answer: Phil Quartararo became president of Warner Bros. Records in 1997, so the relevant Ray Charles album is *Strong Love Affair* (1996). Its title track runs **4:31**; adding one minute gives **5:31**.
